title: Print in Order
instructions: Implement `Foo` in `config/printInOrder.py` with semaphores. `first()`, `second()` and `third()` run in three different threads, in any order, yet must append `"first"`, `"second"`, `"third"` to `self.output` in that order. No sleeping, polling or shared flags.

evidence.label: output starts as an empty list
Outputs first, second, third for every thread start order
second and third block until first has run
third waits for second, not just for first
Separate instances do not share state
